sources.name: Johnson County Conservation camping and access record
observations: Publishes Hills Access map coordinates 41.5544618,-91.5257829, exactly matching both route endpoints.
Describes the site as a 40-acre park along the Iowa River and confirms boat-ramp access to the river.
Lists the site as an active county campground and public recreation facility.
sources.limits: The published point is the site/campground map coordinate, not a separate ramp-toe coordinate.

sources.name: Johnson County Conservation public-use-area record
observations: Describes Hills Access as a river-access park adjacent to the Iowa River with a boat ramp.
Identifies Hills Access as part of the Iowa River Water Trail and an entry/take-out point.
sources.limits: Confirms facility and water-trail use; no ramp toe coordinate is supplied.

sources.name: Iowa DNR Iowa River Water Trail description
observations: Describes the Hills Access to River Junction reach as 9.6 miles and says the reach starts from a cement boat ramp at Hills Access.
sources.limits: Describes the launch by name, without georeferencing the ramp toe.

sources.name: Google Maps satellite imagery at the stored point
observations: The county coordinate is at the 520th Street entrance/approach; the nearby riverbank and launch are separated from the point.
The pin is not the boat-ramp toe, and the image does not justify replacing it with a precise shoreline point.
sources.limits: Visual context only; no coordinate was derived from the screenshot.

decision: Retain the published county site point as an access-site anchor; keep the exact launch toe unresolved.
